name: ZX Spectrum
note: The ZX Spectrum's eight colours at normal and bright intensity, in hardware order (bright black is the same black, so fifteen in all).

from.note: One bit each for green, red and blue plus a brightness bit. Normal intensity at 0xD8 (85 % of full, the voltage ratio Wikipedia's ZX Spectrum graphic modes page gives), values as in Lospec's 'ZX Spectrum' palette (lospec.com/palette-list/zx-spectrum). Real machines differ by model; some emulators use 0xD7.
